roles.jdRaw:
We are looking for a Software Development Engineer Intern to join our engineering team and work on real-world software products.

Responsibilities:
• Build, test, debug, and improve software applications and APIs.
• Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code.
• Work with databases, REST APIs, Git, and development tools.
• Collaborate with engineers and product teams to implement new features.
• Identify and fix bugs and contribute to testing and code reviews.
• Participate in the complete development lifecycle from development to deployment.

Must-Have Requirements:
• Strong programming and problem-solving fundamentals.
• Proficiency in at least one of Python, C++, Java, or JavaScript.
• Understanding of Data Structures and Algorithms.
• Familiarity with Git and GitHub.
• Basic understanding of databases and APIs.

Good-to-Have:
• Experience with React, Node.js, FastAPI, Django, or similar frameworks.
• Personal, academic, or open-source software projects.
• Hackathon or coding-contest experience.
• Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.

Experience:
0–2 years. Students and freshers are welcome.

Education:
Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, AI/ML, or a related field.
